decision: dynamic secret resolution plus atomic file replacement and registry credential generation reset
winner: dynamic resolver + atomic replace + durable counter reset

criteria.correctness: old key is rejected as soon as the secret file is atomically replaced; new key starts at counter 1 after durable reset
criteria.robustness: registry failure rolls the secret file back; transient file/registry split fails closed rather than accepting the old key
criteria.latency: adds one small local secret-file read per authenticated request
criteria.resourceUse: constant-size secret and registry state; no nonce history or network control plane
criteria.regressionRisk: narrow change that reuses WorkerAuthenticator resolver support and DurableWorkerRegistry locking
criteria.qa: tests cover old-key revocation, new-key acceptance, counter reset, file mode, rollback, and secret redaction

alternatives.name: startup-only static secret map plus coordinator restart
alternatives.reason: old credentials remain valid until restart and restart becomes a security-critical coordination dependency

alternatives.name: reset replay counter before replacing secret
alternatives.reason: creates a window where the old key could send low counters again

alternatives.name: versioned dual-key grace window
alternatives.reason: improves availability but intentionally keeps the old credential valid and increases protocol/state complexity

alternatives.name: external secret manager with transactional enrollment
alternatives.reason: strongest multi-host direction but adds deployment, latency, and operational surface before real-Qubes measurements justify it

lessons: credential rotation must revoke the old key independently of coordinator restart
secret replacement must happen before replay-counter reset so the failure window is fail-closed
a failed registry mutation must restore the previous secret to avoid a half-rotated worker
rotation APIs and logs must never return old or new secret material
scope: defensive synthetic DIG worker authentication only
